ai-coding/conflict:open-weight-coding-mo.note: blocked on evidence: Strongest study 0.3 after applicability. SWE-rebench (fresh GitHub issues, one scaffold) shows open-source models ranking alongside the previous generation of closed models, but only for issue fixing on one benchmark

ai-coding/surprise:vibe-coded-apps-work-.note: blocked on evidence: Strongest study 0.36 after applicability. The review supports only the prototype half; the security audit of 200 deployed vibe-coded apps (91% with a validated vulnerability) shows one kind of production failure but measures neither functional breakdown nor scaling and has no human-built baseline.

ai-coding/conflict:specs-code-workflows-.note: blocked on evidence: The post-merge fate study links merging agentic code without review to more later corrective maintenance, but only as a project-level association (R2 6%) with no measure of spec quality; the code-ownership experiment shows understanding loss and the vibe-coding review only recommends reading code.

ai-coding/conflict:goal-loop-commands-pr.note: blocked on evidence: Strongest study 0.27 after applicability.
